proposals.evidence: Both parts repeat the regional alag/agal adjective separate, from alagna (Turner: Hindi alag/algā, Oriya alaga, Old Marwari alago and Gujarati aḷgũ). The metathesized Mewari agal forms are compared with the same regional adjective and retain their source spelling. The full distributive repetition is recorded with two ordered components.
